title: On the performativity of SDG classifications in large bibliometric databases

bias_targets.methodology: Fine-tuning a DistilGPT-2 model on publication abstracts classified under specific Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) by three different bibliometric databases (Web of Science, OpenAlex, and Scopus), and then comparing the generated responses via noun phrase analysis to uncover structural data biases and diverging qualitative perspectives injected by the varying classification systems.
